act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In sub-section (1) of section 145 and sub-section (1) of section 147, for the words
text:
38. In sub-section (1) of section 145 and sub-section (1) of section 147, for the words

“Magistrate of the first class”, the words “Executive Magistrate of the first class” shall
be substituted.
